description.value: The Cutting Board is the on-site restaurant at Kumsheen Rafting Resort, a long-established whitewater rafting destination on the Trans-Canada Highway near Lytton where the Thompson and Fraser Rivers meet. The restaurant occupies a sunroom-style space with sliding French doors opening onto an outdoor patio, serving family-style and buffet meals. All seatings require advance booking, making it a planned stop rather than a casual drop-in for passing cyclists.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the Cutting Board Restaurant is the dining facility at Kumsheen Rafting Resort, located at 1345 Trans-Canada Hwy, Lytton BC. The site confirms phone numbers (250 455 2296 / 1-800-663-6667) and address consistent with OSM's linked URL. Amenity evidence is limited to what the website explicitly states: dietary restrictions are accommodated by the chef, resort washrooms are confirmed via FAQ/reviews, and meals may shift to 'to-go style' under certain conditions but this is not a standard takeout offering.
concerns: Advance booking is required for all meals — the restaurant is not a casual drop-in venue, which significantly limits utility for unplanned stops by touring cyclists.
OSM record has no address or phone; both were sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed fields for phone and address are null.
Website notes meals may be cancelled or converted to to-go format if minimum guest numbers are not met — service is not guaranteed even with a booking.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating seasonal restaurant at a well-established resort on a major cycling route (Trans-Canada Hwy), confirmed open for the 2026 season.
enrichment_extras.notes: The resort also operates a separate onsite coffee bar serving espresso drinks and snacks (mentioned in FAQ), which may be more accessible for cyclists without advance booking, but it is not part of this OSM record.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states: 'Please notify us at the time of booking if you have any dietary restrictions, as our Chef is happy to accommodate.'
